parsed.name: 奥林巴斯 BX2A 显微镜机身
parsed.description: BX2A 是奥林巴斯显微镜的机身/主体平台，用于承载显微镜的光学、照明与运动部件，并在实验中完成样品观察与成像相关的基础操作。根据可见控制项，该机身支持灯状态管理、Z 轴位置调整、运动状态查询以及软限位与原点设置，适用于常规显微观察与实验室成像流程。
parsed.description_en: The BX2A is an Olympus microscope body/stand that serves as the main platform for the optical, illumination, and motion components of a microscope. In laboratory use it supports core observation and imaging tasks. Based on the exposed controls, the body supports lamp status management, Z-axis positioning, motion-state reporting, and soft-limit and origin settings for routine microscopy workflows.

actions.description: 使机身的电动轴按相对位移移动。
actions.description_en: Move the motorized axis by a relative displacement.
